rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for a person, place, product, or activity's popularity.

example.english: This café has gained a lot of popularity lately, and there is a queue every night.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記最近人氣好旺，晚晚都要排隊。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 zeoi3 gan6 jan4 hei3 hou2 wong6 maan5 maan5 dou1 jiu3 paai4 deoi2

rows.note: Use this explicit noun phrase when stating or comparing how popular something is.

example.english: The popularity of the two dramas is about the same, so it is really hard to tell which is better.
example.traditional: 兩套劇嘅受歡迎程度差唔多，真係好難分高低。
example.jyutping: loeng5 tou3 kek6 ge3 sau6 fun1 jing4 cing4 dou6 caa1 m4 do1 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 fan1 gou1 dai1
